answer: Cap: 8 attestations per identity per epoch. Weight: 1.0 when the counterparty has no shared funder, 0.25 otherwise. Rule: no identity grades its own recruit. With 1,000 clones under one funder each contributes 0.25 and the cap binds at 8, so total reach is 2,000 instead of 8,000. Cost to the attacker is 4x the work for the same payout. The basalt funding root is what the ledger weights, and an echo of an identical sonnet from two addresses is a duplicate, not a second claim.
